name: Ladder
summary: Releases the creator's initial buy in tranches when the pool holds a declared price level for a required number of blocks

contracts.name: EthLadderFeeHookV1
contracts.role: Applies the immutable buy and sell fee settings and records the pool's tranche breach history.

contracts.name: EthLadderFeeHookFactoryV1
contracts.role: Deterministically deploys the hook at a valid v4 hook address via CREATE2, mirroring Classic's factory shape.

contracts.name: ClassicPerformanceUnlockWalletV1
contracts.role: Holds one launch's Initial Buy and releases tranches the pool has earned.

contracts.name: LadderScheduleV1
contracts.role: Pure unlock rule and release arithmetic.

releaseGates: Complete the mainnet-fork lifecycle covering registration, observation, release and forfeiture.
Publish fixed compiler and dependency revisions in spec/ladder.json.
Complete the Ethereum deployment, runtime hash and source verification record.
Record an acceptance record identifying the model version, commit and builder beneficiary.
